J-03.name: The statistics core — calibrated, seeded, oracle-proven, fail-closed
J-03.notes: TARGET this iteration; moved partial -> passing. The iter-3 blocking defect is FIXED and the fix was re-proven by the evaluator independently, not accepted from any report. Mechanism check, read from source: the exact-enumeration branch now accumulates each enumerated combination's group-2 sum DIRECTLY over that combination's own complement (referee_stats.py, `if use_enumeration:` block) — the identical method `_t_statistic` uses (`math.fsum(group2)`) — instead of `total - g1_sum`; because `pooled[session]` stores `values = group1 + group2`, the observed grouping's combination reproduces `t_obs` BIT-identically, so its own `_is_extreme` self-comparison can no longer fail and `extreme >= 1` is guaranteed. The developer additionally combined the per-session terms with `math.fsum(terms)` (matching `_t_statistic`'s own numerator) after finding the g2_sum fix alone still left ~7% of 3+-session cases able to violate the floor; disclosed in the dev handoff, reviewed PASS, coherence flagged it visibility-only. EVALUATOR'S OWN MEASUREMENTS: (1) the iter-3 minimal repro now returns p == 2/7 == 0.2857142857142857 exactly (was 1/7); (2) an independent sweep the evaluator wrote from scratch — 2,500 enumeration-mode cases, 1-3 sessions, shapes 2v2/1v4/4v1/3v2/2v3, all three sidedness values, deliberately including a TAIL regime (shifted groups) — found ZERO floor violations with 448 cases sitting EXACTLY on the floor, proving the sweep was in the sensitive regime rather than vacuous; (3) determinism: two independent calls return byte-identical result dicts; (4) `run_oracle_attestation()` executed live returns passed=True with stats_core_version 'referee-stats-v2', `verify_oracle_attestation` returns True for it and False for both a stale-'referee-stats-v1' copy and a tampered-`actual` copy; (5) full backend suite run by the evaluator: 2,513 collected / 2,505 passed / 8 skipped / 0 failed / 0 errors (above the >=2,495/8 floor; 1 test more than QA's own 2,504 because the audit lane added the tail-regime guard after QA ran); (6) Config().config_fingerprint() printed 08e471b10130e1e2; (7) requirements.txt/pyproject.toml zero diff, tests/ zero removed lines. The hard auditor's independent generator agrees (7,035 cases, zero violations post-fix vs 395 on a reconstructed pre-fix build). TWO OPEN GAPS CARRIED FORWARD, neither blocking this journey's own written acceptance: (B1, needs an OWNER RULING) `min_attainable_p` is still served as 1/(draws_used+1) in BOTH branches, a value exact mode provably can never produce — measured by the evaluator on the iter-3 repro: p == 2/7 sits ON the floor while min_attainable_p reads 1/7. docs/referee-statistical-spec.md:168 says 'the minimum attainable p (granularity)', which supports either reading, so per T-1 it is surfaced rather than improvised; it is consumed by nothing today and J-04-J-08 are its first readers. (B2) with a non-finite observation the floor guarantee silently breaks (`_t_statistic` returns NaN, no draw is extreme, the branch returns a below-floor p; `inf` yields a meaningless p) — no input validation exists and none was specified; J-04's adapters are the first producers. (T2) TC-8 checks the n2==1 fast path against a brute-force ground truth within a wide ~6-SE band rather than a deterministic scripted-RNG equivalence, so a small bias could pass.
